scene: You step off the paddle steamer onto the clattering wooden pier.
picture: Flat side view along a wooden dock. On the far left sits the moored paddle steamer. To its right, a boy with messy dark hair, striped green shirt, and red sneakers holds a skateboard. Next stands a neon pinball arcade, then a striped ice-cream kiosk, and on the right stands a tall lighthouse.
